XCH.label: XCH
XCH.description: a plain coin: no family layer, its amount is XCH

CAT.label: CAT
CAT.description: the CAT layer: every child is the same CAT and the amount is kept

SINGLETON.label: singleton
SINGLETON.description: one coin that goes on, one child at a time, with its lineage checked: the singleton top layer, or a contract's own code

UNKNOWN.label: unknown
UNKNOWN.description: the outer layer is not in the catalog: it may wrap the coin, nobody knows yet

XCH.label: XCH
XCH.description: XCH held by someone (a key, keys, an offer, a singleton, anyone)

REVOCABLE_CAT.label: revocable CAT
REVOCABLE_CAT.description: a CAT with the revocation layer

NFT.label: NFT
NFT.description: a singleton with the NFT state layer

DID.label: DID
DID.description: a singleton with the DID inner puzzle

VAULT.label: vault
VAULT.description: a singleton whose inner puzzle is a MIPS custody tree

LAUNCHER.label: launcher
LAUNCHER.description: a coin that launches a singleton or a CAT

SINGLETON.label: singleton
SINGLETON.description: a singleton with no purpose layer

KEY.label: key
KEY.description: a key signs: the standard puzzle, delegated conditions or puzzle, a BLS or EIP-712 member

OFFER.label: offer
OFFER.description: settlement payments: whoever fills the offer

SINGLETON.label: singleton
SINGLETON.description: a singleton spends it (p2 singleton, a vault member)

ANYONE.label: anyone
ANYONE.description: anyone can spend it (quoted conditions, the identity puzzle)

HIDDEN.label: hidden
HIDDEN.description: only the inner puzzle's hash is curried: it shows in the solution

UNKNOWN.label: unknown
UNKNOWN.description: the walk met an unknown layer

project_roles.app: a project that makes its own puzzles: it leads the puzzles it is in (the default)
project_roles.framework: code that apps build on: it leads only a puzzle with no app in it
project_roles.base: the chain's own puzzles: it leads only a puzzle with nothing else in it, and is never a dependency
